summary: Iteration 2 regression + new-feature testing on Grimoire. Backend: 22/22 pytest pass including new endpoints POST /api/cards/collection (resolves Lightning Bolt/Counterspell/Mountain + reports FakeCardNameXyz as not_found) and GET /api/cards/autocomplete?q= (returns suggestion list; empty for <2 chars). Frontend: Guest /build flow verified end-to-end at 1920, 768 and 400 widths. Reported responsive bug is FIXED: header buttons do NOT overflow at any width (maxBtnRight <= headerRight at all three breakpoints) and the search panel renders FULL viewport width when the mobile-tab-search tab is active (768->768px, 400->400px). Import dialog successfully parses plain decklists, MTGA-style '(SET) NUMBER' suffixes, and emits a 'N not found: FakeCardNameXyz' toast while still importing valid cards. After import, inc-/dec-/remove- controls work; imported cards behave like normal deck cards. Autocomplete dropdown appears after 2 chars with 12 suggestions and clicking one runs a search. Full Scryfall search still returns results and Add adds cards. Guest Save opens auth-dialog as expected. Mobile stats sheet renders curve/color/types charts without layout breakage.

issues: Pre-existing Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning when sidebar renders before cards are present. Harmless console noise; not regressed by this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: DeckBuilder.jsx body wrappers correctly use 'w-full lg:w-[38%] shrink-0' for the search column and 'flex-1 min-w-0' for the deck column, which resolves the previously reported ~120px collapsed search panel.
CardSearchPanel root is 'w-full h-full' (width controlled by parent) - good decoupling.
ImportDialog cleanName() strips (SET) NUM / *F* / [tags] / # comments and splits '//' DFC names - robust parsing.
server.py /api/cards/collection chunks names at 75 (Scryfall limit) and caps input at 400 - safe.
server.py /api/cards/autocomplete returns empty for len(q)<2 instead of 400 - matches frontend contract.
seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_* registrations and TEST_Deck created/cleaned by backend tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproducing the search-panel-collapse bug requires using the mobile-tab-search tab at <1024px; current implementation gives the wrapper explicit 'w-full lg:w-[38%] shrink-0' so bounding boxes equal viewport width in mobile tab. Autocomplete suggestion buttons use onMouseDown instead of onClick - use dispatch_event('mousedown') or hover-first in Playwright. Standard-format max-4 cap disables inc- button once reached (expected). Scryfall is live external API; keep tolerant assertions.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: parent flex gave CardSearchPanel ambiguous width causing it to collapse to ~120px on <1024. Fix: wrapper now 'w-full lg:w-[38%] shrink-0' and panel root 'w-full h-full'. Verified: at 768 and 400 widths the panel bounding box equals the viewport width.
